title: Vijayanagara Empire location
subject: History
caption: Map of southern India showing the location of the Vijayanagara Empire as recorded by Domingo Paes.
altText: A textbook‑style map on a white background depicting southern India with the Deccan plateau, major rivers like the Krishna and Kaveri, and the coastline. The Vijayanagara Empire is highlighted in amber, outlined in bold, and labeled “Vijayanagara Empire (c. 1336‑1646)”. The capital Hampi is marked, and a note indicates the period of Krishna Deva Raya. Inset arrows point to the Indian Ocean to the south, the Western Ghats to the west, and surrounding kingdoms. All labels are clear and legible, and the map includes subtle shading to convey topography.
